text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Please save me, Teacher Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good grief~. Don't tell me... is it 'that' 
again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right~?! If I fail the next test, I'm 
practically guaranteed remedial classes!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So it's gonna be a bit of a bummer?! Like, 
mega super bad news~~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, of course I don't mind helping you 
study, but... if we do that—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll help you with your studies, but on 
one condition.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, definitely! Of course! Feel free to 
ask for anything!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pick out questions from the textbook that 
look like they might show up on the test!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real!? What do we do!? I'm, like, the 
type who can't even remember the questions 
from the last test!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"I can't compromise on this, okay? Between 
part-time jobs and practice, I can't teach 
you everything~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Palmer-chin, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! They're dedicating precious time to 
us. Let's answer them with all our heart 
and spirit!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later. When I went to the 
library to look something up—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaah~!? I don't get it! All these 
questions look the exact same to me~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Yeah... It feels like they just 
changed the numbers and the formula 
slightly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios! These are the same questions! It's 
got the same problem-solving methods and 
trends written out the whole time! Which 
means...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Teacher, you're crushing on this problem!? 
Like, get all hyper-focused once your 
crush comes to mind? Dang, am I a master 
detective or what...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right! Now all we gotta do is look for 
problems that can be solved with this 
formula, and we're good to go, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through their own trial and error, both 
worked toward meeting "Teacher" Ines's 
conditions. And then, a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal! So, Trainer, about 
our free time after this—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are! Ines spotted! Are you 
totally down to chat for a sec?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Look! We seriously brainstormed what's 
gonna show up on the test!
choice_data_list: Why don't you hear them out now?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Right. So, which questions do you think 
will be on the test?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Question 2 on page 40, and... Questions 5 
through 10 on page 52! How's that!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, what makes you think that?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh, 'cause I wrote it in my 
notebook using different colored pens and 
everything☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I tried to remember why I changed the 
color, and... I remembered you saying 
'watch out for trick questions'!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Those kinda tricky questions are totally 
sensei's type, right? All I gotta do is 
memorize how to solve 'em, though, so they 
ain't catchin' me off guard!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm, you've memorized how to solve it 
too? So... are there any problems you 
still don't get?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Let's see.......... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it...?! I totally get every single 
bit of this?! OMG, are we, like, 
geniuses?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~, that's too bad. And here I 
went through the trouble of preparing some 
tips~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Super sorry about that! If there's 
anything you don't get either, Ines, feel 
free to come ask me~♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fufu, honestly now~.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's the result of those two working 
hard, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I guess that kind of studying would be 
over in a flash if someone just taught 
them, but still.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
That won't really help in the true sense, 
though. Still...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Looking at her, she'll definitely be 
fine. From next time on, even without me."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all's well that ends well. 
Everything's resolved now♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, all's well that ends well. 
Everything's resolved now♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah? Could it be you're trying to use that 
for me?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to do that, it's fine! 
Different strokes for different folks.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Besides, I quite like the way you teach♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah~. It feels kind of like she's 
outgrowing her big sister, after all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I wonder if I'll be able to hold it 
together when it's Sue-chan and the 
others' turn..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No! But that's what growth is all about! 
If anything, we should be happy for them!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"For when that day comes, I need to steel 
my resolve too!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Foreseeing the end of her duty as an older 
sister, she steeled her resolve.
